Callout.Name: Road Rage Incident
Callout.Message: Two drivers out of their cars on the hard shoulder.
Callout.Advisory: Both on foot, shouting, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: He cut me up at the junction and then he brake checked me.
We both got out. Neither of us threw anything.
He has gone back to his car. That is the part I am watching.

Lines.Approach: Both out of their cars on the hard shoulder. It is loud, it is not violent yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
